I'm a product designer and front-end developer based in San Francisco with 8 years of experience building digital products that people love to use.

I believe great design is invisible — it gets out of the way and lets people accomplish their goals with clarity and confidence. My work spans mobile apps, web platforms, and brand systems.

Previously, I've worked with teams at Stripe, Figma, and several early-stage startups. When I'm not designing, you'll find me hiking the Marin Headlands or experimenting with generative art.
